Iris (Recruiter): Quick flag  a couple of interviewers said their scorecards attached to 'Unknown Reviewer' in the ATS after last night's panels. Candidates: CAND-10102, CAND-10107. Anyone seen identity mismatch errors?

Sam (People Ops): Hmm. Were those interviewers on VPN or using SSO mobile? We had an SSO tweak yesterday evening.

Iris (Recruiter): One used SSO desktop, one used SSO mobile. Both reported they saw a success toast.

Tom (AuthZ): logbot shows a handful of requests where the bearer token refreshed mid-submit. We logged 200 for ingest but reviewer_id was null because auth middleware returned 202 "refresh in progress" then the final write used anon user. Snippet: 
```
POST /ingest/scorecard 200
auth: "refresh_in_progress"
stored: reviewer_id=null
```

Nora (Hiring Enablement): That would orphan qualitative feedback and break debrief at debrief time. Can we backfill reviewer_id from request logs?

Tom (AuthZ): Plan: (1) change auth middleware to block final write while token refresh is in-flight (fail-fast) so client sees error instead of silent anon; (2) run a replay matching request_id -> session events to recover reviewer_id for affected posts. I'll open RECR-4225.

logbot: RECR-4225 created (assignee=Tom, priority=high)

Sam (People Ops): Good. Also add a short training note to interviewer guide: "avoid hitting submit while your SSO is in the middle of refresh; wait for solid network/connectivity confirmation". We should include a short sentence in the onboarding module.

Iris (Recruiter): I'll message the two interviewers asking for copies of their comments just in case. Can we also add an admin audit column to the scorecard view showing "created_by_session_id" so we can triage faster next time?

Tom (AuthZ): Yes I'll add a lightweight audit field and wire it to logs. ETA for patch: 24-48 hours. For immediate recovery, I'll run a dry-run replay and post which candidate scorecards we can reassign.

Nora (Hiring Enablement): After recovery let's add a 3-min clip to the interviewer sync showing how to confirm identity pre-submit (top-right avatar + initials).

Sam (People Ops): Assigning tasks: Tom  auth fix + replay; Iris  outreach; Nora  training clip; Sam  update handbook. Please update RECR-4225 as you make progress. Thanks :thumbsup:
